mrd.text: Glissa Sunseeker, a Viridian elf, declared that there was a secret at the heart of Mirrodin and that she would unlock it, believing someone was defying the gods and shaping the planet.
Her path began with loss, as levelers killed her parents and sister, and she was later captured, freed by Slobad, and healed at Taj-Nar before discovering that Memnarch was behind the attacks.

Glissa gathered the three Kaldra artifacts and summoned the Kaldra champion, but Memnarch seized control of it, Bosh sacrificed himself so his friends could escape, and the unstable mana core gave birth to the Green Sun.
Locked in stasis for five years, she later fought Memnarch in the Core and her spark passed to Slobad, which led to the Vanishing and Karn's gift of the Mirari to Glissa, Slobad and Geth.

dst.text: Glissa fought her way through the Lumengrid and down into the Pool of Knowledge after Chunth entrusted her with the secret that the world is hollow.
Fleeing vedalken pursuers, she discovered that Memnarch was real and waiting for her, and when Malil's levelers cornered her she channeled green fire in an explosive burst that disabled them.

She learned that Memnarch planned to use the green sun's power and her spark to become a planeswalker, and when Memnarch took control of the Kaldra champion, the fifth sun dawned; Glissa and Slobad survived the blast.

5dn.text: Glissa, Bosh and Slobad journeyed to Mirrodin's core with the Kaldra avatar to confront Memnarch, who seized it with a single spell and turned it on them.
The avatar chased Glissa into the Tangle until, at the Radix, her body called forth a column of green mana that destroyed it and became the green sun of Mirrodin's fifth dawn.
Memnarch trapped her in a temporal bubble for five years, but she woke, rallied survivors and threw herself at him as his spark device activated, so that both fell into the mana core.
Karn then restored the souls, causing the Vanishing, and gave the Mirari to Glissa, Slobad and Geth.

som.text: After Glissa Sunseeker defeated Memnarch the green sun burned in Mirrodin's sky, and she disappeared; the elves blamed her for their misfortunes and called her Glissa the Traitor.
She retreated into Mirrodin's core, where small constructs carried her down and kept her unconscious, until the Praetor Vorinclex compleated her and unleashed her as a Phyrexian ally for the siege.
As a Phyrexian she sent Tezzeret to bring Elspeth to her, and Tezzeret betrayed her as she attacked alongside Phyrexians.

nph.text: Within New Phyrexia, Glissa argued that the Phyrexians should strike the surface at once rather than wait to build a full-scale assault, and pressed them to leave the Core.
She built a powerful faction by exploiting discontent and surviving assassination attempts with Vorinclex's help, and the two pioneered a method of escalated growth.

She warped crotus blooms into crotus beasts as her enforcers and sent them on killing missions into the Tangle before the attack began, so the forest was firmly hers when Phyrexia emerged and the Sylvok were hit hardest.
